headline: La-Z-Boy Reports Second-Quarter Sales Growth in Retail and Wholesale
summary: La-Z-Boy Incorporated reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 results featuring an 11% increase in retail written sales and a 14% rise in delivered sales, alongside store network expansions.
why: La-Z-Boy is a major manufacturer and retailer of residential furniture, providing visibility into consumer discretionary spending and home furnishings demand.

impacts.name: La-Z-Boy Inc
impacts.why: Strong quarterly sales growth in retail and wholesale segments drove positive business results.
